# Effects library: blocks and loop-reset transitions (generated by tools/gen_effects_md.py, do not edit by hand)

**49 effect blocks** (`assets/template/fx.js`, copied into each project by `new_project.py`) and **27 frame-level loop-reset transitions** (`scripts/reset.py`).

**What this is for**: a toolbox. Use what helps, skip it entirely, adapt a block, or write your own. The signature move should be designed for each image; blocks work best as supporting actors, atmosphere and loop transitions, or as raw material for a signature move (for example, steam that gathers into the title). Sprinkling a few blocks over the untouched source image is usually too small an action.

## How to use blocks

```js
// src/index.html (the template already loads fx.js)
const g = FX.layer();                                       // transparent canvas covering the source image (design coordinates); put it in #cam
const rain = FX.make('rain', { seed: 7, ...FX.pick('rain', 7), angle: 12, area: [0, 0, 1, .8] });
await rain.ready;                                           // await inside build() (some blocks sample the source image first)
function render(t) { g.clearRect(0, 0, CFG.srcW, CFG.srcH); rain.draw(g, t); }
```

- **Areas and points are 0..1 fractions** of the source image: `area: [x0, y0, x1, y1]`, `from: [x, y]`. Measure with `measure.py grid` instead of eyeballing.
- **Seamless loops**: periodic motion completes a whole number of cycles per loop, so t = 0 and t = CFG.dur look the same. When changing params, keep things like `speed / cycles / turns` as integers.
- **Avoid sameness**: use a different `seed` for each film (e.g. derived from the slug). `FX.pick(name, seed)` draws a random param set within the recommended ranges; then adjust the key ones for this image (area, color, direction).
- **Grow it from the picture**: `dust` settles in bright areas, `fireflies` in dark ones, `sparkle / glow / twinkle` find the source image's highlights, `bokeh / confetti` take the picture's colors with `palette: 'auto'`, and `smoke` picks gray or white smoke from the background brightness. When you set areas by hand, tie them to something real in the picture (water, sky, lamps, the rim of a bowl).
- **Camera blocks** (parallax / drift / shake): `parallax` draws the whole image itself and goes on the bottom layer (run `depth.py` first); `drift` / `shake` set a transform on `#cam`: `cam.apply(document.querySelector('#cam'), t)`, or combine them with `L.Camera.apply(el, t, shake.at(t))`.
- **In-picture transitions** (backplay / passby / pushcut / lightcut): total duration = main action + tail. In `render(t)`, drive the main action with `R.time(t)` and draw `R.draw(g, t)` on the top layer (a canvas inside `#view`, outside `#cam`); for pushcut also call `R.apply(view, t)`. These feel more like part of the film than the frame-level `reset.py`.
- **Reveal blocks** (draw / paint / inkbloom / grow / write / pop) default to `mode: 'pulse'`: full image, recede, grow back, so first and last frames match. `mode: 'in'` plays once (the film starts blank and ends with a loop-reset transition).
- **Supporting actors shouldn't steal the scene**: many blocks moving at once tend to move independently of each other; supporting blocks usually look classier with slightly lower amplitude and opacity than the defaults. Big main action, steady support.

## Supporting actors: pick by what's in the picture

When looking for supporting actors, list the things in this picture that **could naturally move** and check this table for ready-made blocks. Reference only.

| In the picture | Common blocks | Also possible | Loop-reset candidates |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lamps, lanterns, candles, lit windows, neon | glow · flicker · twinkle · godrays | bokeh · dust · embers · sparkle | lightcut · leak · burn |
| Sun, light through windows, backlight | godrays · grade · shadows | dust · vignette · texture | lightcut · sweep · develop |
| Sky, clouds | clouds · grade | godrays · rain · snow | passby(cloud) · sweep · mist |
| Water, lakes and seas, reflections, puddles | water · ripples · caustics | rain · sparkle · godrays | pushcut · passby · lightcut |
| Fog, mountains, layered distance | fog · parallax · drift | clouds · godrays | mist · ink · steam |
| Hot food, drinks, hot springs, pots | steam · haze | bubbles · sheen · grade | steam · leak · passby |
| Grass, flowers, trees, plants | sway · petals · shadows | dust · fireflies · grow | brush · watercolor · passby(leaves) |
| Hair, hems, flags, ribbons, curtains | wave · sway | petals · dust | passby · brush |
| Portraits (photos) | parallax · wave(hair) · grade | bokeh(background) · dust · vignette · shake(selfie) | passby · develop · sweep · leak |
| Animals, characters, dolls (illustration) | blink · breathe · sway(tail) | petals · sparkle · fireflies | watercolor · squash · brush |
| Sleeping people or animals | breathe | dust · shadows · steam(hot drink) | lightcut(dark) · mist |
| Round things: wheels, gears, suns, planets, records | spin | sparkle · sheen | zoom · lightcut |
| Metal, jewelry, glass, packaging, products | sheen · sparkle | bokeh · caustics · vignette | sweep · flash · shatter |
| Titles and lettering (posters, calligraphy) | write · sheen | texture · grain | paper · brush · halftone |
| Chat screenshots, UI, lists, infographics | pop · write | pulse · confetti(celebration) | pop(out) · glitch · mosaic · crt |
| Clean line illustrations, sketches, architecture, children's drawings | draw · paint | texture · grow | erase · crayon · paper |
| Ink wash, Chinese painting, watercolor | inkbloom · fog · paint | petals · ripples · snow | ink · mist · watercolor |
| Famous paintings, oil paintings | paint · parallax · drift | texture · godrays · fog | brush · develop · paper |
| Old photos, black and white, film look | grain · scratches · drift | vignette · texture | develop · burn · rewind |
| City at night, starry skies, traffic | twinkle · pulse · grade | rain · bokeh · snow | lightcut · crt · glitch |
| Parties, birthdays, celebrations, holidays | confetti · flicker(candles) | bokeh · sparkle · snow | pop · flash · squash |
| Impact, streetwear, cyberpunk, sports | chroma · shake · pulse | embers · rain · sparkle | glitch · shatter · zoom · crt |
| Flat color, graphic posters, logos | sheen · draw · pop | texture · grain · confetti | paper · halftone · squash |

Among the loop-reset candidates, backplay / passby / pushcut / lightcut / pop(out) are in-picture transitions (fx.js); the rest are `reset.py --kind`.

## Blocks · Particles (10)

| Block | Effect | Suits | From the picture |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rain` Rain | Rain streaks fall at a slant in several depth layers: thick and long up close, thin and short far away | rainy nights, street scenes, windows, umbrellas, cinematic looks | It is already raining in the picture, the ground has puddles, someone holds an umbrella, or a night scene should feel wetter |
| `snow` Snow | Snowflakes drift down in depth layers, swaying side to side: big and soft up close, small and crisp far away | winter, snowy scenes, holidays, night scenes, cozy moods | The picture has snow, a cool palette, winter clothing or holiday elements |
| `dust` Light dust | Dust motes float slowly in the light and twinkle; they only appear in bright areas | window light beams, backlight, interiors, libraries, old houses | The picture has light beams, window light or backlight (motes are scattered by the source image's brightness) |
| `bokeh` Bokeh | Soft round out-of-focus highlights drift and breathe; colors come from the lights in the picture | night scenes, night markets, string lights, holidays, portrait backgrounds | The picture has blurred lights, neon or string lights; colors are sampled from the bright areas by default (palette: auto) |
| `petals` Petals | Petals (or leaves, ginkgo) tumble and spin as they fall, slanting with the wind | cherry blossoms, spring, weddings, classical Chinese style, autumn (leaf / ginkgo) | The picture has flowering trees, blossoms, autumn leaves, or a classical figure that needs a little wind |
| `fireflies` Fireflies | Fireflies wander slowly through the dark, blinking on and off | summer nights, forests, picture books, fairy tales, lakesides | Night scenes, grass, woods; they land in the dark parts of the source image by default |
| `embers` Embers | Sparks rise from a fire, twisting as they fly, shifting from yellow to red and burning out | campfires, candles, fireworks, blacksmiths, gold leaf, warm light | The picture has fire, lamps, candles or a stove; `from` gives the fire's area |
| `bubbles` Bubbles | Bubbles wobble upward with bright rims and specular dots (soap mode gives floating iridescent soap bubbles) | drinks, underwater, fish tanks, refreshing moods, blowing bubbles | Glasses, water, aquariums, bubbles; `area` is where bubbles can rise (e.g. inside the glass) |
| `confetti` Confetti | Paper confetti and streamers tumble down | birthdays, celebrations, openings, New Year, sales | Parties, cakes, balloons, celebratory text; palette: auto uses the picture's colors |
| `sparkle` Sparkle | Cross-shaped star glints flash in turn on the brightest highlights of the picture | jewelry, watches, metal, water, eyes, glass, holidays | Finds the source image's highlights automatically (points: auto), or give points by hand |

## Blocks · Light (8)

| Block | Effect | Suits | From the picture |
|---|---|---|---|
| `godrays` God rays | Shafts of light stream from a source (window, sun, gap in the trees), swaying slowly and pulsing | windows, forests, churches, stages, backlit portraits, early morning | The light source; `from` is the source point (can be off-canvas), `dir` / `spread` set the direction and cone angle |
| `glow` Breathing glow | A halo settles over bright spots such as lamps, windows and fire, and slowly breathes in and out | lanterns, chandeliers, candles, neon, lit windows, night scenes | Finds the lamps in the source image automatically (bright spots, color taken from the lamp); points can also be given by hand |
| `flicker` Candle flicker | Firelight jumps irregularly: the flame's halo grows and shrinks and the warm light across the frame brightens and dims with it (neon mode gives the flicker of a faulty neon sign) | candles, campfires, fireplaces, oil lamps, neon signs | Where the flames or tubes are: give `points` by hand, or let it find the brightest points inside `area` |
| `sheen` Sheen sweep | A diagonal highlight sweeps across a surface, lighting only areas that are already bright (metal, glass, packaging, foil lettering) | products, watches, jewelry, packaging, cars, metallic type, logos | `area` frames the product or shiny surface; maskBy: light keeps the highlight on bright surfaces only |
| `shadows` Leaf shadows | Shadows of leaves outside a window fall on walls and tables and sway gently in the wind | windows, interiors, afternoons, cafes, bedrooms, portraits | Lit walls, tabletops, floors; `area` frames that surface |
| `pulse` Light pulse | Strings of light dots run along lines (fiber optics, neon tubes, circuits, traffic lanes) with trails | tech, fiber optics, circuits, city traffic, neon, data | The direction of lines in the picture; `paths` gives one or more polylines (0..1 coordinates), drawn as smooth curves |
| `grade` Changing daylight | The tone of the whole frame or the sky slowly shifts and comes back: warm and cool, bright and dark, like the time of day passing | cities, landscapes, skies, dusk, blue hour, nightfall over a city | The sky or the whole scene; framing only the sky with `area` changes only the sky; `lights` makes lamps brighter as it darkens |
| `twinkle` Twinkling lights | Many small lights in the picture (lit windows, street lamps, stars) each brighten and dim on their own | city nights, starry skies, string lights, Christmas, distant lights | Finds small bright points in the source image automatically (color taken from each light) |

## Blocks · Local motion (5)

| Block | Effect | Suits | From the picture |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sway` Sway | Things in the region sway side to side like grass, flowers, branches or a hanging lamp; the root stays still and the tip moves most | grass, flowers, trees, reeds, wheat, hanging lamps, ornaments | `area` frames what should sway (top edge a bit above the tips); `root` is bottom (growing from the ground) or top (hanging) |
| `wave` Flutter | Flags, ribbons, hems and long hair ripple as if in the wind, with waves running out from the fixed end | flags, ribbons, scarves, skirts, long hair, kite tails, curtains | `area` frames what flutters (with a little margin); `fixed` is the anchored end |
| `breathe` Breathe | A region gently swells and shrinks, like a sleeping cat breathing or a balloon puffed by the wind | sleeping animals and people, balloons, bread, hearts, glowing objects | `area` frames the body or object that breathes; `center` is the swelling center (defaults to slightly below the region's center) |
| `blink` Blink | A character blinks: the eyelids close from top to bottom and open again | illustrated characters, animals, dolls, avatars, mascots | Eye positions and sizes: eyes = [[x, y, r], ...], where r is the eye radius as a fraction of the frame width |
| `spin` Spin | Round things turn in place: suns, wheels, gears, records, windmills, clock faces | suns, wheels, gears, records, windmills, round logos, dials | `items` gives centers and radii (r as a fraction of frame width); for gears use symmetry = tooth count, and a whole number of teeth per loop gives a seamless loop; give `mask` / `plate` when the background is uneven |

## Blocks · Camera (3)

| Block | Effect | Suits | From the picture |
|---|---|---|---|
| `parallax` Depth parallax | Slices the picture into many layers by depth; as the camera gently orbits or pans, near things move more than far ones, giving a 3D feel | landscapes, portraits, street scenes, interiors, any photo with clear foreground and background | Needs a depth map from scripts/depth.py (near = white); this block draws the whole image itself, so put it on the bottom layer |
| `drift` Push, pull, pan | The camera slowly pushes in and pulls back, drifts in a small circle, or pans gently, ending where it started | almost any still: landscapes, posters, products, famous paintings | `focus` is the point to push toward (e.g. the subject's face); use cam.apply(document.querySelector("#cam"), t) instead of L.Camera |
| `shake` Handheld shake | The slight shake of a handheld camera; `hits` adds a jolt at given moments | selfies, street photography, documentary, sports, music festivals, impact | Usually layered on another camera move: L.Camera.apply(el, t, shake.at(t)); on its own use shake.apply(el, t) |

## Blocks · Grow and reveal (6)

| Block | Effect | Suits | From the picture |
|---|---|---|---|
| `draw` Line drawing | First traces the picture's lines stroke by stroke like a pen, then fills in color patch by patch until the original is back | illustrations, sketches, architecture, picture books, children's drawings, prints, logos | Extracts lines from the source image automatically (details darker than their surroundings); `area` can limit it to one region |
| `paint` Brush painting | The picture is brushed in with broad strokes whose edges show dry-brush streaks | oil paintings, watercolors, famous paintings, posters, illustrations, handmade looks | The whole frame or an `area`; works well right after "Line drawing" |
| `inkbloom` Ink bloom | The picture appears by spreading out from a few ink drops, with a dark tide line along the edges | ink wash, watercolor, calligraphy, Chinese-style posters | Starts from the darkest spots of the source image (where the ink is heaviest) by default; `seeds` can be given |
| `grow` Growing vines | Vines grow from a starting point, branching and sprouting leaves (and small flowers) | decorative borders, spring, florists, weddings, fairy tales, children's drawings | `from` gives the start point and growth direction (e.g. climbing up from a bottom corner); colors can be taken from the picture's greens |
| `write` Line-by-line writing | The text in the picture is "written" line by line, left to right (or top to bottom), led by a glowing pen tip or cursor | titles, calligraphy, handwriting, poster text, captions, chat screenshots | `lines` gives a box for each line of text (in writing order); the background under the text should be fairly even (it is covered with the box-edge color first) |
| `pop` Pop in | Elements in the picture (bubbles, stickers, icons, cards) pop in one by one with a little bounce | chat screenshots, UI, infographics, stickers, lists, poster elements | `items` gives a box for each element (in order of appearance); the background should be fairly even (it is covered with the box-edge color first) |

- `draw`: `area`=[0, 0, 1, 1], `mode`="pulse", `t0`=0.08 0–0.3, `dur`=0.6 0.3–0.8, `order`="sweep", `dir`=20 -180–180, `lines`=1 0.5–2, `paper`="#f6f1e7", `ink`="#2a2622"
- `paint`: `area`=[0, 0, 1, 1], `mode`="pulse", `t0`=0.08 0–0.3, `dur`=0.6 0.3–0.8, `strokes`=7 4–12, `angle`=-20 -60–60, `paper`="#f3eee4"
- `inkbloom`: `area`=[0, 0, 1, 1], `mode`="pulse", `t0`=0.06 0–0.3, `dur`=0.6 0.3–0.8, `seeds`="auto", `count`=3 1–6, `edge`=0.5 0–1, `paper`="#f4efe3"
- `grow`: `from`=[[0, 1, -60]], `length`=0.55 0.3–0.9, `branches`=4 1–8, `curl`=1 0.4–2, `width`=1 0.6–1.8, `mode`="pulse", `t0`=0.05 0–0.3, `dur`=0.65 0.3–0.8, `stem`="#4f7a3a", `leaf`="#7fb35a", `flower`=null
- `write`: `lines`=[[0.1, 0.4, 0.9, 0.5]], `dir`="right", `mode`="pulse", `t0`=0.08 0–0.3, `dur`=0.6 0.3–0.8, `tip`="glow", `color`="#ffffff", `plate`="auto"

## Blocks · Texture (5)

| Block | Effect | Suits | From the picture |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grain` Film grain | Film grain that changes every frame, a staple of old photos and cinematic looks | old photos, film, cinematic looks, night scenes, retro | Whole frame; use mono for black-and-white photos |
| `scratches` Scratches and dust | Vertical scratches, dust specks and hairs of old film flicker in and out | old photos, silent films, retro posters, film, archival looks | Whole frame |
| `vignette` Vignette | Darkens the corners, optionally breathing slowly, to draw the eye to the center | portraits, old photos, cinematic looks, night scenes, products | Put `center` on the subject |
| `chroma` Chromatic aberration | Red, green and blue channels split slightly (more toward the edges) and can jump to a beat | cyberpunk, streetwear, music, tech, glitch art, neon, black-and-white graphics | Whole frame; this block draws the whole image itself, so put it on the bottom layer |
| `texture` Paper texture | Overlays a paper, canvas, linen or kraft texture; a soft light can slowly sweep across the paper | illustrations, watercolors, posters, handmade looks, retro; digital images that want a handmade feel | Whole frame |

- `grain`: `amount`=0.2 0.08–0.4, `size`=1.2 0.7–2, `mono`=true, `frames`=8 4–16, `blend`="overlay"
- `scratches`: `amount`=1 0.4–2, `lines`=2 0–5, `dust`=14 0–40, `hair`=0.3 0–1, `light`=0.6 0–1
- `vignette`: `amount`=0.55 0.25–0.8, `size`=0.62 0.4–0.9, `breathe`=0.15 0–0.4, `speed`=1 1–2, `center`=[0.5, 0.5], `color`="#000000"
- `chroma`: `amount`=1 0.3–2, `pulse`=0.6 0–1, `speed`=4 1–8, `radial`=true
- `texture`: `kind`="paper", `amount`=0.3 0.12–0.55, `scale`=1 0.6–1.8, `light`=0.1 0–0.3

## Blocks · In-picture loop reset (4)

| Block | Effect | Suits | From the picture |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backplay` Rewind to start | After the main action, the whole sequence plays back quickly to the first frame (slow, fast, slow), like time reversing | films built up from blank, growth, assembly, drawing processes, films with a story | The main action itself; good when the first and last frames differ a lot but the process is worth watching |
| `passby` Foreground pass-by | A very close foreground object (pillar, leaves, cloud, silhouette) sweeps across the lens, and the first frame is swapped in while it covers the view | street scenes, interiors, landscapes, posters, any film (the most versatile in-picture reset) | Pick a `shape` that suits the picture; the color defaults to the source image's darkest tone (pillars, leaves) or white (clouds) |
| `pushcut` Push-in cut | The camera pushes hard into a small evenly colored patch (shadow, sky, paper); at full push the first frame is swapped in, then it pulls back out | pictures with large even color areas; especially good when the first frame is blank paper or a solid color | `focus` is a point where the first and last frames have about the same color (e.g. sky, paper, shadows) |
| `lightcut` Light pull-back | The picture darkens until only a ring of light around the source remains (or brightens into a wash from the source); at the darkest / brightest moment the first frame is swapped in, then light spreads back out from the source | pictures with lamps, windows, sun or fire; night scenes; use bright when the first frame is blank paper | `from` is the light source (defaults to the brightest spot in the source image) |

- `backplay`: `tail`=1 0.6–1.6, `curve`="inout"
- `passby`: `tail`=1 0.6–1.6, `shape`="pillar", `dir`=1, `color`="auto", `cut`=0.5 0.4–0.6
- `pushcut`: `tail`=1 0.6–1.6, `focus`=[0.5, 0.5], `zoom`=9 5–14, `blur`=1 0–2
- `lightcut`: `tail`=1 0.6–1.6, `mode`="dark", `from`="auto", `color`="auto", `glow`="#ffd59a"

## Frame-level loop-reset transitions (`scripts/reset.py`)

`pagecurl`, `iris` and `ripple` have tended to look cheap in practice; prefer others unless the image really calls for them.

Post-processing that works on any film: it appends a segment that carries the last frame back to the first (the content doesn't have to return to the start by itself). `reset.py <frames dir> --kind <kind> [--seed N] [--origin x,y] [--dir lr|rl|tb|bt | --angle deg] [--color #hex]`; without `--dur` the default duration is used. Changing `--seed / --origin / --dir / --color` varies the shape and color of the same transition; put the origin on a light source, the subject or the visual center of the picture.

**Nature**

| Kind | Effect | Suits | Default duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mist` Mist | A bank of mist rolls in and covers the frame; as it clears, the first frame is underneath | mountains and water, landscapes, fog, dreamy moods, ink wash | 0.9s |
| `ink` Ink spread | Ink seeps out from a few spots and floods the frame; as it recedes, the first frame is underneath | ink wash, watercolor, calligraphy | 1.0s |
| `watercolor` Watercolor bloom | The first frame blooms in like watercolor paint from a few spots, with pigment pooling at the edges and wet areas slowly drying | watercolor, illustration, picture books, flowers | 1.0s |
| `ripple` Ripple | A ripple spreads from a point; behind the wave the first frame appears and the water settles | water, lakes, rain, reflections, fresh light styles | 1.0s |
| `steam` Steam | A plume of steam rises from below across the frame, the air shimmering with it; when it clears, the first frame is there | food, coffee, hot springs, winter, kitchens | 1.0s |
| `defog` Fogged glass wipe | The frame fogs up like glass, and a hand wipes it clear in a few strokes; wiped areas show the first frame | rainy days, winter, windows, night scenes, cafes | 1.2s |

**Handmade**

| Kind | Effect | Suits | Default duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| `brush` Brush | A few broad diagonal brush strokes sweep back and forth with dry-brush edges (--strokes sets the count) | hand-drawn work, collage, calligraphy, brush-lettering posters | 0.7s |
| `erase` Eraser | An eraser rubs away the last frame, revealing the first frame where it passes | children's drawings, pencil sketches, journals | 0.8s |
| `paper` Paper pull | The whole sheet is yanked away, revealing the first frame underneath | print, posters, layouts, collage | 0.6s |
| `pagecurl` Page curl | The last frame lifts from a corner and the whole page turns away, a little of the picture showing through its back, with the first frame underneath | picture books, magazines, diaries, journals, book pages | 0.9s |
| `tear` Paper tear | The last frame is torn in half down the middle and pulled apart, ragged edges showing white paper core, with the first frame underneath | collage, posters, clippings, journals | 0.85s |
| `halftone` Halftone | The last frame turns into print halftone dots, the dots shrink away, the first frame's dots grow in, and it resolves into the first frame | print, pop art, comics, retro posters | 1.0s |
| `crayon` Crayon scribble | Like a child scribbling with a crayon: first gappy strokes, then cross-hatching that fills in, the strokes carrying paper grain | children's drawings, crayon art, journals, playful illustrations | 1.2s |

**Light and film**

| Kind | Effect | Suits | Default duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sweep` Light sweep | A soft band of light sweeps across the frame; behind it the first frame is already there | photography, products, landscapes (a dark --color turns it into a passing cloud shadow) | 0.7s |
| `develop` Develop | The picture fades to photo paper and the first frame develops in like a photograph, shadows first | old photos, film, photography | 1.0s |
| `iris` Iris | The picture shrinks into a circular iris and vanishes; outside it is the first frame | retro, film, comics, silent films | 0.6s |
| `flash` Flash | A flash of white (or a chosen color) cuts back to the first frame | universal fallback; high-impact films (--color changes the flash color) | 0.4s |
| `leak` Light leak | Warm film light leaks in from an edge and burns the frame bright; as it fades, the first frame is there | film, everyday photos, travel, retro, portraits | 0.9s |
| `burn` Film burn | The last frame burns through like film stuck in a projector, a scorched, glowing edge spreading out with the first frame in the hole | film, retro, cinematic looks, dark moods | 0.9s |
| `rewind` Rewind | The whole film rewinds quickly to the first frame like a videotape, with tracking noise, scanlines and ◀◀ | life logs, vlogs, retro, films with a plot | 1.0s (needs frames of the whole film) |

**Digital**

| Kind | Effect | Suits | Default duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dissolve` Pixel dissolve | Square pixels dissolve in a direction, with a bright rim along the dissolving edge | pixel art, cyberpunk, UI, games | 0.6s |
| `glitch` Glitch | Signal failure: rows shift, RGB channels split, color blocks jump, and it cuts back to the first frame mid-jitter | cyberpunk, streetwear, electronic music, tech, UI | 0.6s |
| `mosaic` Mosaic | The last frame's pixel blocks grow larger; at the largest it switches to the first frame, then sharpens back step by step | pixel art, games, UI, tech, pop art | 0.7s |
| `crt` TV switch-off | The last frame collapses into a bright line and then a dot like an old TV turning off, then switches back on to the first frame | retro, TV, games, Y2K, nostalgia | 0.8s |

**Motion**

| Kind | Effect | Suits | Default duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| `squash` Squash | The whole picture is squashed flat into the floor and disappears, revealing the first frame | clay, 3D, chibi styles | 0.5s |
| `shatter` Shatter | The last frame cracks from a point and breaks into glass shards that fall away, revealing the first frame | impact, sports, glass, tech, streetwear posters | 1.1s |
| `zoom` Zoom through | The camera rushes into the last frame (with radial blur), comes through on the first frame, then pulls back from close up to its resting position | sports, travel, cities, streetwear, fast pacing | 0.6s |
